entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input 1 is the ONLY edit target, the actual Ireland 2026 Council of the EU presidency coin photograph. Inputs 2 and 3 are surface-finish references only. Make a conservative photographic colour/lighting retouch of target 1: clean neutral satin-silver ring, VERY PALE champagne-gold centre, pure white background matching the references. Preserve every original engraved element EXACTLY. The central multi-arm spiral of small raised beads is locked: keep every bead, its number, size, exact location, group spacing, branch curvature and orientation; do not add, delete or move any dots. Preserve the stylized Irish country inscriptions at the top and bottom and the two vertical side inscriptions and dates exactly as source pixels, with accents, letter forms, case and spacing unchanged. Follow the source, do not infer or rewrite ambiguous glyphs. Preserve all twelve original stars, rim outlines and relief shadows. Change only surface colour casts, mottled dirt and background grayness. No regeneration of the dot pattern, no new lettering, no simplified stars, no invented detail or metal texture. Maintain entire coin and original orientation, slight white margin, single catalogue coin. No saturated yellow gold or mirror chrome.
